functions.name: marks

evidence.locator: Literal j9, Unicode character offsets[611443,612819); ABI entry[0]

economic_meaning.detail: Tries pairOracle.twapNetUsdg; positive return sets twapLive=true, otherwise uses cached lastTwapWad with false. Returns raw reserve spot, Treasury backing floor and sNET index; index raw9, NET USD prices WAD. Does not update cache and does not promise price freshness merely because cache exists.

functions.name: boundedMarks

evidence.locator: Literal j9, Unicode character offsets[611443,612819); ABI entry[1]

economic_meaning.detail: Requires nonzero live-or-cached twapRef. Clamps spot between floor(twapRef*9700/10000) and floor(twapRef*10300/10000); zero spot uses twapRef. Returns index and original twapLive. Bound is versus TWAP, not Treasury floor.
